branch.DEFAULT_BRANCH: Never delete default branch (aoss-main, main, master)
branch.ACTIVE_PR_OPEN: Branch has open PR - keep (low risk)
branch.RECENT_NO_PR: Last commit < 30 days, no PR - keep (low risk)
branch.STALE_NO_PR: Last commit > 90 days, no PR - review for deletion (medium risk)
branch.RECENT_PR_MERGED: PR merged recently (< 30 days) - delete soon (low risk)
branch.OLD_PR_MERGED: PR merged > 30 days ago - delete candidate (medium risk)

pull_request.STALE_PR: No activity > 90 days - review for closure

issue.STALE_ISSUE: No activity > 90 days - review for closure
